notes.title: Spring changes
notes.notes:
Changes
Main

 Added speedrun leader list, you must pass LVL 5 to get into it.
 Demo version updated to "people update" version.
 Now all objects reproduce the sound of the impact, this sound is quieter and has a weaker priority for playback.
 Bugfix. a serious bug was discovered and fixed due to which the player was awarded points from exploding cars, even when the game did not start, there were suspicions that the top players got their points exactly in that way, therefore the whole table of results was reset.
 Added most used screen resolutions
 Added machine translation into Finnish, German, Japanese, languages.
 Now the charge pressure boost is automatically turned on if ready for more than 15 seconds.

LVL 3

 Now cars accelerate the removal of a destroyed object which interferes with the movement of the car, traffic jams are less likely.
 Now the place the appearance of the helicopter is not fixed
 Сars now emit smoke from the exhaust pipe

LVL 4

 Explosion damage changed, now the damage depends on the current pressure of the player, the greater the pressure, the more damage will be, so the tanks became much more dangerous.
 Health of nuclear power plant Increased from 500 to 1,500.
 

LVL 5

 Added army helicopter.
 Tsunami health slightly reduced.
 Added second weaker rumble sound for tsunami.
 Added tsunami water spray particles.
 Now timer stops after the destruction of the tsunami.


What's next?
Most likely I will have to switch to the development of another game because the piisim does not bring enough so that I can survive without support, if you want to help the development of this game, you can donate through paypal, as soon as the amount of $ 120 is collected, I will develop the update, this is enough for me for a month of life. your name specified in paypal will be added to the list of thanks when loading the game. In the next update, I would like to add more objects to generate, such as a power plant with power lines, a neighbor's house on the other side of the street, with more detailed destruction, and the interior of the apartments, railway with trains, and other exterior objects on the street.
Thanks for playing.

notes.title: People update
notes.notes:
People have been added to the game.
This is the most basic change in the current update.

More detailed list of changes below:



LVL 1

 Tiles on the wall on the left and right can now be destroyed


LVL 2

 Added people
 Сhanged the path in front of the house, so that people do not get stuck


LVL 3

 Added tarp truck
 Cars after destruction spawn people
 Сar wheels now bounce
 Fixed bug when wheels are not removed and at the end of the game there are a lot of them.
 Сars always let pedestrians pass
 Now the number of live cars cannot exceed 50


LVL 4

 Tanks now have a black hole texture
 Reduced start threshold of damage for a nuclear power plant


LVL 5

 Added another ring for animating an underwater atomic explosion


Other

 Shader has been completely replaced
 Settings menu changed
 Now PiiSim can support languages other than English
 Russian translation text added
 Now you can change the resolution from the game
 If now “overtime” mode and you are straining, then your pressure does not fall.
 Alpha of fear emotion texture is changed, now teeth do not shine through.
 In the game loading mode, a list of donators has been added. This list will be updated with the release of game updates.
 Remote start menu with graphics settings, due to uselessness
 loading is noticeably faster


What's next?
During the spring, small updates will be released that fix bugs that I did not have time to notice, and in general minor corrections regarding the visual design. 
In the summer, if there is community support, a major update will be developed that will affect gameplay at all levels except 1. Namely, I want to improve randomization, add new enemies like an army helicopter firing rockets, add train and add targets etc.
I would also like to add new achievements, and other leaderboards such as Speedrun leaderboard.
For a year I had a lot of time to think about what the players want, but due to poor sales I had to be distracted by other projects and this I did not do so intensively, now you can always help PiiSim development through PayPal on koker007@yandex.ru

Thank you for being and enjoy the game.

notes.title: Сrowdfunding for Big Update PiiSim
notes.notes:
Hello, I know that it’s quite late, but if you like this game and you want to develop it, then with this purpose, crowdfunding was launched.

This big update will include:

 Add support for other languages
 Rebild level 2, adding offices
 Improve cars behavior
 Add people in a minimalistic visual style, but with complex behavior
 More sounds
 Fix bugs
 More targets
 More humor and absurdity
 Upgrade randomization
 Add Twice More Achievements
 Add Level 6: water targets, new enemies, mountain terraforming, yellow clouds and more


If you want to see this update then you can support me here
Fundraising will last 2 months using crowdfunding.

Video with English subtitles.

in case of a successful fundraising, you can follow the news and vote here
and the this update will be released in a year.

notes.title: Any changes - small update
notes.notes:
Main change

 Pressure scale is now on envelops of score
 Added pause on "pause" button
 A bit more information in the tutorial


LVL 2

 Added new 1 advertising for standard size billboard


LVL 3

 All cars give more points, this level has become easier
 The helicopter has less health
 Helicopter gives more points
 Now than a helicopter is further than that, its flight minimum is higher. that's why he shouldn't be stuck


LVL 4

 Tanks give more points


LVL 5

 Tsunami has more health
 Tsunami gives less points



What's next
There will be a big discount soon. This game has bad sales, and it is difficult for me to continue developing it, so there is a risk that not everything that was intended will be implemented. If the discount does not help, then most likely the game will be released from early access earlier. 
Now the game looks close to a complete one, so soon there will be updated on the randomization of the world. 
Have Fun!

notes.title: Randomization update 1
notes.notes:
Main change

 With the pressure of the damage radius more
 Now when the pressure is up, the camera shifts left and right by the amount of pressure
 The main house appears at a random place along the first road.
 Some targets are automatically deleted when the game starts, if they are too far from the player
 cleaned opaque pixel on the back of the head of the animation for the picture smile-right-closed


LVL2

 reduced minimum pressure threshold for lvl 2

notes.title: Tsunami update
notes.notes:
Global change

 Priority of emotion of fear became higher than emotion of aggression


LVL 2

 Traffic light gives you the normal points


LVL 3

 The number of points received for a large billboard has increased
 All cars have 4 times more points (about 100-200)
 The average billboard has become heavier
 Killing a helicopter gives you a full charge


LVL 5

 On lvl 5 the police do not attack
 On lvl 5 all cars move twice as fast
 Added tsunami



What's next?
I think to fix many bugs to play was nicer, simplify mouse control, because there were complaints about it.
I also understand how to make a world leaderboard for those who have no friends with this game. This table will also work on server steams so it will take me time to figure out how these functions work.
And then i will start global randomization.

Main change

Rest change

Bug fix

what's next?

Have a epic playing!
